Lie Algebras, Algebraic Groups,
and
Lie Groups
J.S. Milne
Version 2.00
May 5, 2013
 
These notes are an introduction to Lie algebras, algebraic groups, and Lie groups in
characteristic zero, emphasizing the relationships between these objects visible in their cat-
egories of representations. Eventually these notes will consist of three chapters, each about
100 pages long, and a short appendix.
